name: view_duel_fizzle_shown
description: A bottle with no valid reveal fizzles (design 1.4, contract-m7.md §2: fizzle_t 1500 after the horn), shown on Undertow's own rules against the caretaker. In window 2 a pack is corked, and the game then forgets its salts as one started again offline does (no salts' file): the bottle stands, but nothing here can open it. During wave 2 the tray's socket says it is lost and its tooltip why, Space says so instead of 'Nothing is corked', and the client sends no UNCORK at 24 s. At 25 s after the horn the simulation fizzles it: the notice says so, the socket empties, the gold stays spent, no creep walks the rival's road for me and my stipend does not grow; the rival's hollow, held for the bottle until then, clears.

steps.assert: Game.my_bottles().size() == 1 and not Game.my_bottles()[0]['known'] and Game.my_bottles()[0]['pack'] == ''
steps.msg: the game forgot its salt: the bottle stands, nothing here opens it
the socket says it is lost, and carries no Space key

steps.assert: node('DriftTray').tip_shown()[1].begins_with("Its salt is not on this machine any more")
node('Notice').text == "That bottle's salt is lost: it will fizzle" and resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 7).is_empty()
steps.msg: Space says so, and sends nothing
no UNCORK went out at 24 s, and at 25 s the simulation fizzled it

steps.assert: Game.my_bottles().is_empty() and node('DriftTray').mine_shown().is_empty() and node('Notice').text == 'Your bottle fizzled: nothing walks, the gold stays spent'
steps.msg: the notice says so and the socket empties
no stipend, and no creep of mine on the rival's road
the rival's hollow, held for the bottle, clears wave 2
